text:
maria: heads-up for folks running the interviewer calibration tomorrow: several interviewers reported seeing old scorecard labels in their panel view (v2) while the ATS shows v3. this is during the 11am calibration session.

owen: when did the ATS migration to v3 roll out? i thought it was last week.

maria: it did, but i think some cached templates were still referenced by our interviewer webapp. an interview squad tried a mock interview and the rubric had outdated rubrics for 'communication' vs the new 'collaboration' label.

sophie: omg. that's the exact change we reviewed in the rubric workshop. could be confusing during calibration. any idea which service is serving the stale view?

ben: tagging engineering: we have a template-cache-service that pulls scorecard config from /config/scorecards endpoint and caches for 24h. last deploy changed default ttl to 24h -> maybe that caused stale configs to persist.

people-ops-bot: automated: calibration session "Interviewer Calibration - Nov 21" scheduled at 2025-11-21T11:00:00Z. Attendees=24.

maria: impact: 24 interviewers in training, possible inconsistent scoring. can we get a hotfix or a rollback of TTL?

owen: i can flip the cache TTL to 0 for the webapp env and clear the cache. will do now.

ben: if we clear the cache we should also force refresh on the ATS webhook that contains scorecard version metadata. otherwise some clients may still fetch the stale payload.

sophie: temporary mitigation: can recruiting ops attach the canonical scorecard PDF to the calendar invite for the session so everyone references the same rubric?

maria: yes please. i'll upload a single PDF to our drive and attach to the invite. will note 'use this rubric only' in the calendar description.

owen: cache cleared and TTL set to 0 for webapp. issuing a pubsub event to signal clients to reload configs.

ben: pubsub event sent: scorecard-refresh v3. monitoring logs for 200s.

ats-bot: webhook: scorecard config update received for version=v3 at 2025-11-20T18:12:05Z.

nowen: can folks in the training confirm they now see the v3 labels?

sophie: i just asked two interviewers in the channel; both confirm the new labels appear.

maria: ok great. follow-ups: 1) ops to add a check in the deployment checklist to invalidate template-cache on scorecard schema changes; 2) engineering to add an integration test that compares ATS version header to served config; 3) people-ops to always attach canonical rubric for training sessions for the next quarter.

ben: noted, i'll create ENG-OPS ticket to add cache-invalidation step.

people-ops-bot: ticket created: ENGOPS-712.

maria: thanks everyone. saved the session. also leaving a note in the interviewer-playbook about this gotcha. :white_check_mark:
